title: Single Port Versus Four Ports Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy and Early Postoperative Pain
brief_summary: This is a trial to evaluate if single port laparoscopic cholecystectomy causes less pain than conventional laparoscopic cholecystectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA I-III
* Planned elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy because of biliary pain or uncomplicated biliary pancreatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Expected poor compliance
* History of cholecystitis or severe pancreatitis
* Earlier open upper abdominal surgery, pregnancy or lactation, chronic pain or conversion to open surgery
